The contents list is not labeled; Items 1 to 15 each have one body heading, and nothing is absent. The forward-looking statements note between PART I and Item 1 belongs to no Item. Items 1B and 9 say 'None.', Item 8 only points to the statements, and Items 11, 13 and 14 only incorporate the proxy statement, so they are marked incorporated. Hard call (the labelers differed, not scored): Item 10 refers to the proxy statement but adds a code of ethics paragraph of its own (whom the code covers, where it is posted, how changes and waivers are disclosed, how to request a copy), so it is not marked, as in the fresh3 Dole 2012 and O'Reilly 2005 labels and the fresh2 Funko 2026 label. Item 12 prints an equity compensation plan table and is not marked. Item 15 holds the exhibit list and ends at SIGNATURES (line 1148), the filing end; the financial statements follow the signatures.
